headline: Taiwan Stocks' Fourth Institutional Investors Go Wild! Regular Investment Inflows into 0050 and 0056, Deduction Amounts Hit New Record High - Finance
summary: Taiwan stocks strengthened in August as fourth-category institutional investors' regular investment funds flowed in. Deduction amounts for 0050 and 0056 hit record highs of NT$13 billion and NT$2.4 billion.
why: Yuanta's 0050 tracks Taiwan's top 50 listed companies and 0056 is a high-dividend ETF, making them major vehicles for Taiwan equity flows. Regular investment inflows are a steady source of domestic demand.
